summary: Iteration 181 - Sacred Ally Improvements Testing Complete. All 3 top improvements implemented and working: (1) Guided ally audio journeys - 5 seeded journeys (Dragon, Whale, Dolphin, Metatron, Michael) with playable GuidedAudioButton in detail modal, (2) Sacred ally pathways - 3 seeded pathways (Dragon 21-day, Whale 14-day, Metatron 21-day) with modules displayed in modal, (3) Personalized daily recommendation - POST /api/sacred-ally/daily-recommendation returns ally + journey + pathway based on mood/moon/intention with anti-repeat logic. Frontend shows roadmap card with P0/P1/P2 phases and recommendation panel that accepts inputs and renders results.
